units.source_text: 这房间在二楼，可癞蛤蟆在屋子围墙周围绕来绕去地鸣叫着。

en.t: The room was on the second floor, but toads were croaking as they wandered round and round the wall around the house.

units.source_text: 好像不是一只，而是两三只。

en.t: It seemed there was not just one, but two or three of them.
They went on croaking for a long time.
